forms.title: Nigeria Landing Card (Nigeria Immigration Service, Landing and Exit Cards)
forms.stoppedAt: "Apply for Landing Card" leads to an account login (email and password, with sign-up); the public pre-login steps ask for a passport number.

steps.name: Select your landing passport type to proceed

fields.label: Choose the type of passport type you want to verify

notices: Provide your valid visa or passport number as it appears on the document. Ensure accuracy to avoid processing delays.
Ensure all details such as: Name, date of birth, and nationality match your official identification documents to prevent processing delays.
Valid visa holders with no expired or revoked status.
